$comment:
The finish (feature 009, specs/009-finish-line-crowd). Read by the renderer only, never by the simulation: everything past the line is drawn, so no value here can change a run, a score or the rules version (FR-264).

holdTicks and reducedHoldTicks: the finish holds on the mountain exactly as long as the wipeout does (death.ts TOTAL and REDUCED_TOTAL). FR-266 forbids a finish being a longer wait than a crash.

runoutEase: past the line the drawn ground eases from the course's last slope to flat over this many units (research R1). The course data itself continues at 0.6 and then kinks flat; flat ground cannot go in the data because CV-23 and B8 check every segment, and ground no run reaches is not worth a rules version.

stopDistance and stopWithinTicks: after touchdown the skier brakes at whichever rate stops him sooner, within this many units or this many ticks (R2). Measured speed at the line runs 2.75 to 6.89 u/tick, so every rider is stopped with over a second of the hold left to be seen stopped.

frameLead and frameFollow: the camera stops following once the line is frameLead units inside the frame's left edge, so the gantry and the crowd share the frame, and resumes if the skier would pass frameFollow units into it (R7).

gantryHeight and bannerWidth: the gantry's crossbar above the piste at the line, which must clear the tallest shelf plus a standing skier (test D2), and the banner's width centred on the line.

crowdFrom, crowdTo and crowdSpacing: the crowd stands from crowdFrom to crowdTo units relative to the line, one figure slot every crowdSpacing units, in two rows (FN-2).
